description: Holographic demo skill pack — proves the Sparkleware to Aeon install pipeline works end to end. Owned by the Sparkleware team as a reference implementation.
long_description_md:
## What this is

The **first real pack** listed in the Sparkleware registry. It exists to demonstrate the full install flow: `./install-skill-pack sparkleware/demo-pack` clones this repo, parses its `skills-pack.json` manifest, scans the declared skills, and installs them into your Aeon root.

## What it does

One skill: `sparkle-status` — fetches the current Sparkleware pack-author count from the live registry, prints a holographic ASCII status banner, and (optionally) appends a one-line memory note. Idempotent, no destructive ops.

## How to publish your own

See [registry/CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sparkleware/sparkleware/blob/main/registry/CONTRIBUTING.md). Two paths: auto-discovery (add the `aeon-skill-pack` GitHub topic to your repo, wait ~24h for the daily crawler) or verified submission (open a PR adding `registry/packs/<your-handle>/<pack-name>.json`).
